title: Mean of the second coordinate
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$ and let $n$ be any natural number. Under the correlated distribution on pairs of sign vectors that chooses the first uniformly and keeps each coordinate for the second with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the expected second coordinate of their normalized sum is zero.
